The '''All Terrain Scout Transport/Assault (AT-ST/A)''' was a variant of the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]].

==Characteristics==
It was approximately 10 meters tall, and was more heavily armed than its shorter cousin, sporting a large, single-barreled heavy [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] instead of the double medium [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] cannons.

The AT-ST/A's legs had greater reinforcement, and its gyro-stabilizing systems were improved from the original design. It was also fitted with enclosed viewports for added protection of the crew.

==History==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] spies first spotted the vehicle early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], but variants of the AT-ST/A design would continue to be deployed throughout the conflict, even participating in the devastating [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Second Battle of Coruscant|in-fighting]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AT-ST-variant.png|thumb|right|180px|Sketch of an unnamed AT-ST variant from ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', similar to the AT-ST/A.]]
The AT-ST/As originated in concept art for the ground-battle on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], where it was to have taken the role of the AT-ST (which would be modified from its [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']]-appearance).

Ultimately, a slightly different look was chosen and the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] recycled the designs into a bigger, stronger AT-ST variant, more suited for an assault-role.
